reason: The README clearly describes a plugin that converts pasted or path-specified images into text descriptions using the DashScope qwen-vl vision API, with browser and tool integrations.

summaries.zh: 通过阿里云百炼 qwen-vl 视觉模型，将粘贴或指定路径的图片转换为文字描述，供文本模型理解和处理。
summaries.en: Converts pasted or path-specified images into text descriptions with the DashScope qwen-vl vision model for use by text-based models.

capabilities: Reads user-selected local image files by path
Captures pasted images in the web interface
Sends image data to the DashScope qwen-vl vision API
Returns image descriptions as tool results or draft text
Provides a loopback RPC endpoint between browser and host components
